name: GetOrganelle

name: NOVOPlasty

use_zh: 细胞器组装（2017 文）。README 现为 4.3.3：仅双端、不要质量修剪、植物线粒体用 mito_plant 且先组装叶绿体。异质性检测另引 lqz011。
note: README + 2017 full text; wrapper keeps the older 4.3.1 example script name; heteroplasmy paper is P19

name: Freudenthal 2020 comparison

use_zh: 短读长质体默认推荐 GetOrganelle；早于 HiFi 工具。
note: full text

name: PMAT

use_zh: 低覆盖 HiFi 植物线粒体组装。CLR/ONT 须先用 Canu 或 NextDenovo。
note: README + full text; UNRUN; version from opened README

name: Oatk
use_en: Syncmer assembler for PacBio HiFi only (not CLR/ONT); profile-HMM; best-supported path; 195 plant species. README: set -c as 5–10× nuclear coverage to help filter nuclear sequence and NUMTs; -c 30 is the Arabidopsis example.
use_zh: 仅 PacBio HiFi（不是 CLR/ONT）；syncmer 组装、HMM、选最佳路径。-c 取核覆盖度的 5–10 倍；-c 30 是拟南芥示例。
note: README + full text; UNRUN; HiFi-only scope from README

name: PMAT2
use_en: Graphical organellar assembly toolkit for plant, animal and fungal mitochondria and plant chloroplasts; abstract mentions ~1× HiFi. Parameter names differ from PMAT (-t seqtype, -G organelles, -x taxo). README install also points at aiPGAB/PMAT2.
use_zh: 图形化细胞器组装，适用于植物/动物/真菌线粒体和植物叶绿体；参数名与 PMAT 不同。
note: full text + README; second repo not cloned; flags must not be copied from PMAT

name: MitoHiFi
use_en: PacBio HiFi mitochondrial pipeline. README section 6 says, verbatim, it is still not optmized to assemble a plant mitochondria or chloroplast; -a plant is used with -c to finish and annotate an existing plant organelle contig. The paper says Viridiplantae runs should use -a plant, and also that plant outcomes may vary. NUMT separation is in the README. Not a direct replacement for plant graph assemblers. The paper dataset is 368 metazoans and 6 fungi.
use_zh: PacBio HiFi 线粒体流程。README 第 6 节原话：still not optmized to assemble a plant mitochondria or chloroplast；-a plant 只与 -c 一起，用于给已有植物细胞器 contig 收尾和注释。论文写 Viridiplantae 应使用 -a plant，同时也写植物上 outcomes may vary。不能直接替代植物图组装器。
note: full text (PMC10354987) + README re-opened 2026-11-15 CST. The finding/circularising slogan is repo metadata, not the README body. Restored 'not a direct replacement' caution.
